home.title: Scents that take you somewhere.
home.description: Complex, rich and emotional. Familiar but new. Each scent invites new meaning through your own wear, designed inclusive of gender, identity and the things we carry. At our core is the reminder of all that connects us.

about.title: This is UA SCENTS
about.description: UA SCENTS is a world of scents that take you somewhere. Complex, rich and emotional. Familiar but new.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Are the fragrances vegan/cruelty free? Our Eau de parfums are vegan, cruelty-free and made with practices that help uphold the 9 million species who share our home. Do we ship outside of the United States? The world is quite large. For now, we ship to the US from uascents.com. With time, we'll bring our Eau de parfums to more of the world.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: UA SCENTS is committed to making our website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We are actively working to improve the accessibility and usability of our website, and we strive to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as our standard.
